audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1-5 read Vayne or Skill while every why and spike underneath says Illaoi owns Levels 2 through the first item.
audit.why: Mirror (illaoi__vayne) landed Vayne at Level 1, Illaoi from Level 2 through the first item, Vayne at 2+ items. This file's own mid text says 'Levels 2-6 are all Illaoi' and spikes[2] says 'Still her window' — only the enums disagreed.
audit.corrected: Chart: Vayne, Illaoi, Illaoi, Illaoi, Illaoi, Illaoi, Vayne, as matched pairs with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[5] said Vayne starts out-pacing her at one item, contradicting spikes[2] on the same page.
audit.why: Prophet of an Elder God heals Illaoi every time a tentacle damages a champion. One Blade of the Ruined King does not out-damage that sustain; the flip is at two items with Final Hour.
audit.corrected: whys[5] now states the first item is still hers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Illaoi's Q is called 'Grab (Q)' in spikes[1] — it is Tentacle Smash. Ranges and cooldowns were absent throughout.
audit.why: Test of Spirit reaches 900 on 16s falling to 12s, against your 550 Condemn — she outranges your only disengage, which is the single most important number in the lane. Harsh Lesson is a 400-range leap on a 4s cooldown, so Condemning her off buys seconds rather than ending the engage. Leap of Faith is 450 range on 120/95/70s and spawns a tentacle per champion hit.
audit.corrected: Real names and the 900-vs-550 range gap and 4s Harsh Lesson written in.

audit.why: The packet flagged 'Land Test of Spirit' as a probable wrong name — false positive, it is the correct E name with a verb in front. Separately, the kit's derived flags mark Leap of Faith as grounding and untargetable; Riot's own description contains neither, so I did not assert them anywhere.
audit.corrected: No name change for Test of Spirit; no untargetable/grounding claim made for Leap of Faith.

edits.before: With her first item Vayne's Final Hour kiting starts to out-pace Illaoi's tentacle slams from outside the field.
edits.after: At one item Illaoi's passive tentacle healing still out-sustains Vayne's single Blade of the Ruined King.

edits.before: Once Illaoi has tentacles up she owns the mid-lane phase: standing near her Prophet of an Elder God tentacles means each slam hits huge %-max-health chunks, and her Test of Spirit (E) rips your soul so tentacles chase you. Never fight near her tentacle field — poke from max range with Tumble autos and step out of tentacle windup animations.
edits.after: Once Illaoi has tentacles up she owns the mid-lane phase: standing near them means each slam hits huge %-max-health chunks, and Test of Spirit (E) reaches 900 to rip your soul so tentacles chase you. Harsh Lesson (W) is only a 4s cooldown, so Condemning her off buys seconds, not a trade — poke from max range and step out of the windups.

edits.before: Leap of Faith (R) summons a ring of tentacles that shred you and heal her — if you're caught in the field with your spirit tore, you die. Hold Condemn to knock her out of R range or peel her Grab (Q) empowered slam, and never let her E land on you in a tentacle nest.
edits.after: Leap of Faith (R) is 450 range on a 120s cooldown and spawns a tentacle for every champion it hits, and each one that connects heals her. Condemn her out of that 450, and never let Test of Spirit land on you inside a nest — it outranges Condemn 900 to 550.

edits.before: Dodging this is the whole matchup. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Test of Spirit reaches 900 on a 16s cooldown — it outranges Condemn.

edits.before: Illaoi wastes Test of Spirit — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Harsh Lesson is a 4s dash, so Condemn only buys a few seconds.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Tentacles heal her every time they connect — bring anti-heal.

notes: Fabricated ability name found that the packet missed: spikes[1] called Illaoi's Q 'Grab (Q)' — it is Tentacle Smash; the sentence has been rewritten around Leap of Faith's real 450 range and 120s cooldown instead. The decisive number, Test of Spirit reaching 900 against your 550 Condemn, was nowhere on the page and now is. The kit's derived flags claim Leap of Faith grants untargetability and grounding; Riot's description says neither, so I did not write them. diff read 'HARD' while diffRating, tone and report[14] all said favoured 4/10 — set to FAV. Open item the mirror agent raised and I could not settle either: whether Condemn's knockback breaks the Test of Spirit tether.
